spans.text: Do NOT invent facts. If something is not present in any summary, mark it UNKNOWN or omit it.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly promotes truthfulness and information integrity by instructing the AI not to invent facts, to mark unknown information as UNKNOWN, to not contradict confirmed facts, and to prefer earlier summaries as canonical for historical facts. These are strong information integrity safeguards.
